name: Dongsaengz' Summer Vacation
overview: Three members of TOMORROW X TOGETHER—BEOMGYU, TAEHYUN and HUENINGKAI—set off on a carefree summer vacation filled with camping, water activities, games, horror experiences and unforgettable memories. Through their journey, the "Dongsaengz" enjoy moments of healing, laughter and friendship while creating a summer diary together.
